## Episode Thesis

This is a holiday special of VG's Norwegian personal-finance podcast Pengerådet. The host answers listener questions on how fund accounts are taxed (the tax-free return allowance and first-in-first-out rule), whether to pay down mortgages or invest spare cash, and how to split savings between BSU (a tax-advantaged youth home-savings account), money-market funds, bond funds and IPS (individual pension savings). The guidance is generic: cheap global index funds over concentrated Nordic or Norwegian holdings, and lower risk as the time horizon gets shorter. No single-stock buy or sell views are given.
